t: 法国国王弗朗西斯一世授予让-弗朗索瓦·罗贝尔瓦勒(Jean-François Roberval…
te: King Francis I of France gives Jean-François Roberval a commission to settle the province of New France (Canada) and pr…
dz: 法国国王弗朗西斯一世授予让-弗朗索瓦·罗贝尔瓦勒(Jean-François Roberval)一个解决新法兰西行省(加拿大)问题的委员会,并规定"天主教信仰"的传播.
de: King Francis I of France gives Jean-François Roberval a commission to settle the province of New France (Canada) and provide for the spread of the "Holy Catholic faith".

t: 智利圣地亚哥由佩德罗·德·瓦尔迪维亚所建立.
te: Santiago, Chile is founded by Pedro de Valdivia.
dz: 智利圣地亚哥由佩德罗·德·瓦尔迪维亚所建立.
de: Santiago, Chile is founded by Pedro de Valdivia.

t: 弗朗西斯·克萨维尔出走里斯本,前往葡萄牙东印度群岛执行任务.
te: Francis Xavier leaves Lisbon on a mission to the Portuguese East Indies.
dz: 弗朗西斯·克萨维尔出走里斯本,前往葡萄牙东印度群岛执行任务.
de: Francis Xavier leaves Lisbon on a mission to the Portuguese East Indies.

t: 国王亨利八世下令在每个教堂放置英文圣经。 1539 年，伟大的圣经将为此目的而提供。
te: King Henry VIII orders English-language Bibles be placed in every church. In 1539 the Great Bible would be provided for…
dz: 国王亨利八世下令在每个教堂放置英文圣经。 1539 年，伟大的圣经将为此目的而提供。
de: King Henry VIII orders English-language Bibles be placed in every church. In 1539 the Great Bible would be provided for this purpose.

t: 埃尔南多·德索托 (Hernando de Soto) 在现今密西西比州沃尔斯 (Walls)…
te: Hernando de Soto stops near present-day Walls, Mississippi, and sees the Mississippi River (then known by the Spanish a…
dz: 埃尔南多·德索托 (Hernando de Soto) 在现今密西西比州沃尔斯 (Walls) 附近停留，看到了密西西比河（当时西班牙人称为 Río de Espíritu Santo，该名称由阿隆索·阿尔瓦雷斯·德皮内达 (Alonso Álvarez de Pineda) 于 1519 年起）。
de: Hernando de Soto stops near present-day Walls, Mississippi, and sees the Mississippi River (then known by the Spanish as Río de Espíritu Santo, the name given to it by Alonso Álvarez de Pineda in 1519).

t: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗在利马被他的前同伴、后来的对手、小迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗的儿子暗杀。阿尔马格罗…
te: Francisco Pizarro is assassinated in Lima by the son of his former companion and later antagonist, Diego de Almagro the…
dz: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗在利马被他的前同伴、后来的对手、小迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗的儿子暗杀。阿尔马格罗后来被捕并被处决。
de: Francisco Pizarro is assassinated in Lima by the son of his former companion and later antagonist, Diego de Almagro the younger. Almagro is later caught and executed.

t: 法国探险家雅克·卡蒂埃(Jacques Cartier)在第三次去加拿大的航行中在魁北克市附近…
te: French explorer Jacques Cartier lands near Quebec City in his third voyage to Canada.
dz: 法国探险家雅克·卡蒂埃(Jacques Cartier)在第三次去加拿大的航行中在魁北克市附近登陆.
de: French explorer Jacques Cartier lands near Quebec City in his third voyage to Canada.

t: 奥斯曼土耳其人夺取了匈牙利王国的首都布达.
te: The Ottoman Turks capture Buda, the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom.
dz: 奥斯曼土耳其人夺取了匈牙利王国的首都布达.
de: The Ottoman Turks capture Buda, the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom.

t: 智利圣地亚哥遭到由道奇马隆科领导的土着勇士的袭击,以释放被西班牙人囚禁的八名土着酋长.
te: Santiago, Chile, is attacked by indigenous warriors, led by Michimalonco, to free eight indigenous chiefs held captive …
dz: 智利圣地亚哥遭到由道奇马隆科领导的土着勇士的袭击,以释放被西班牙人囚禁的八名土着酋长.
de: Santiago, Chile, is attacked by indigenous warriors, led by Michimalonco, to free eight indigenous chiefs held captive by the Spaniards.

t: 西班牙征服者埃尔南多·德索托和他的军队进入位于今阿肯色州西部的图拉领地，遭遇猛烈抵抗。
te: Spanish conquistador Hernando de Soto and his forces enter Tula territory in present-day western Arkansas, encountering…
dz: 西班牙征服者埃尔南多·德索托和他的军队进入位于今阿肯色州西部的图拉领地，遭遇猛烈抵抗。
de: Spanish conquistador Hernando de Soto and his forces enter Tula territory in present-day western Arkansas, encountering fierce resistance.

t: 托马斯·卡尔佩尔和弗朗西斯·德勒汉姆因与英格兰女王和亨利八世的妻子凯瑟琳·霍华德有染被处死.
te: Thomas Culpeper and Francis Dereham are executed for having affairs with Catherine Howard, Queen of England and wife of…
dz: 托马斯·卡尔佩尔和弗朗西斯·德勒汉姆因与英格兰女王和亨利八世的妻子凯瑟琳·霍华德有染被处死.
de: Thomas Culpeper and Francis Dereham are executed for having affairs with Catherine Howard, Queen of England and wife of Henry VIII.
